town: Scilla, and his son born at Messina
reason: He is thirty-three when his son is born in December 1816, so his own birth and marriage are pre-civil at Scilla — and his elder son MICHELE was born at MESSINA about 1814, where registration does not begin until 1820.
evidence: His age comes from Scilla Nati 1816 atto 207, copied into his son's marriage bundle of 1844. The Messina wall was probed year by year across the whole province: 1815 nothing, 1819 nothing, 1820 three hundred and sixty-six volumes. Sicily had no Napoleonic period, so there is no earlier series to fall back on. FamilySearch's «Messina, Civil Registration (State Archive), 1820-1865» confirms the same start year from a different filming.
route: PARISH REGISTERS, Archdiocese of Messina or Diocese of Reggio Calabria.
